title: June Discretionary Closure Day
excerpt: The third Friday of June is a discretionary closure day.
body: The third Friday of June is a discretionary closure day for staff training. Families needing emergency care should apply to their campus in advance.

title: Summer English Camp Registration Open
excerpt: Sign up for our summer English camp with native teachers.
body: This July we run a month-long summer English camp with native teachers. Water play, English cooking and outdoor adventures let children experience English naturally.

title: Shuttle Bus Route Update
excerpt: Some shuttle routes and times are being adjusted.
body: Reflecting traffic conditions, some shuttle bus routes and pickup times are being adjusted. The updated timetable is shared via newsletter and the app.

title: English Library Renovation Complete
excerpt: Our 3,000-book English picture-book library has been renewed.
body: Each campus English library has been refreshed with over 3,000 age-graded English picture books and cozy reading nooks to encourage a love of reading.

title: June Meal Menu
excerpt: Here is the June lunch menu.
body: Please find the June lunch menu prepared by our nutritionist. Allergen-containing foods are marked separately on the menu for your reference.

title: Gwangju Campus Opening
excerpt: Our Honam-region hub, the Gwangju campus, opens.
body: Hanbit opens a new kindergarten campus in Gwangju, bringing English-immersion early education with native-speaking teachers to families in the Honam region.

title: June Parent Information Session
excerpt: An information session for new and current families.
body: On the second Saturday of June, each campus hosts a parent session introducing Hanbit's English-immersion curriculum and daily routine. Reserve a spot in advance.

title: Parent App Maintenance Notice
excerpt: The app will be briefly unavailable for maintenance.
body: To keep the service stable, we will perform parent-app maintenance. Access may be temporarily limited during the maintenance window.

title: 2027 Admissions Now Open
excerpt: Applications for the 2027 school year are open across all campuses.
body: We are accepting applications across our kindergarten programme for 2027. Information session dates are on the Events page.

title: 2026 Native Teaching Team Joins
excerpt: Meet the native teachers joining us this year.
body: Native teachers with rich early-childhood experience have joined the Hanbit family. Co-teaching with homeroom teachers strengthens our English-immersion environment.

title: English Musical Day 2026
excerpt: Children's English musical performances, all in one place.
body: Our annual English Musical Day returns this year, with children singing and acting on stage in English.

title: Spring Nature Field Trip
excerpt: Children met spring in the woods and fields, in English.
body: We held a spring nature field trip to nearby woods and parks. Children observed flowers and insects and described them in English, learning through all five senses.

title: Regular Health Check-up Notice
excerpt: A spring health check-up for all children.
body: Together with our partner clinic, we hold a spring health check-up for all children. Schedules and preparation details are shared via our family newsletter.

title: New Uniform Design Unveiled
excerpt: A new uniform with more comfort and freedom to move.
body: Designed for active little ones, our new uniform uses softer, eco-friendly fabrics. Ordering details will be announced separately.

title: New Phonics English Program
excerpt: A new play-based way to learn English.
body: We have introduced a new phonics programme where kindergarten children learn English through sounds and play.

title: English Reading Awards Ceremony
excerpt: We celebrated children who read steadily all term.
body: Wrapping up the autumn-winter English reading challenge, we held a reading awards ceremony, celebrating children who grew closer to books a little each day.
